sentences.en: The city center of Algiers glitters like any major metropolis.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及尔市中心像任何大城市一样闪闪发光。

sentences.en: The water between the moss-covered stones glittered in the sun.
sentences.zh: 长满苔藓的石头之间的水在阳光下闪耀着光芒。

sentences.en: My sister dumped a bunch of glitter on my bed.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹把一大堆闪粉洒到了我的床上。

phrases.zh: 并不是所有闪光的东西都是金子。

senses.zh: 闪闪发光，灿烂，闪烁，辉耀
